verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of David. After Doeg the Edomite went to Saul and told him, “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.” Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.

xrefs.text: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Now one of Saul’s servants was there that day, detained before the LORD. And his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief shepherd for Saul.
No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case honestly. They rely on empty pleas; they tell lies; they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.

verses.text: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.

xrefs.text: Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
There are six things that the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to Him:
My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
“They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,” declares the LORD.

verses.text: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking truth. Selah

xrefs.text: “They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,” declares the LORD.

You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, refusing to uphold the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
They exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is forever worthy of praise! Amen.
But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

verses.text: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.

xrefs.text: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
So the king ordered Doeg, “You turn and strike down the priests!” And Doeg the Edomite turned and struck down the priests himself. On that day he killed eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.

verses.text: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah

xrefs.text: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.
Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.
He is torn from the shelter of his tent and is marched off to the king of terrors.
Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.

verses.text: The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,

xrefs.text: The righteous see it and are glad; the innocent mock them:
He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.
Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.

verses.text: “Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”

xrefs.text: This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
As no man has power over the wind to contain it, so no one has authority over his day of death. As no one can be discharged in wartime, so wickedness will not release those who practice it.
They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.
Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
If I have put my trust in gold or called pure gold my security,

verses.text: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.

xrefs.text: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
His shoots will sprout, and his splendor will be like the olive tree, his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon.
He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
The LORD once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.

verses.text: I will praise You forever, because You have done it. I will wait on Your name— for it is good— in the presence of Your saints.

xrefs.text: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
